subject: saving myobj to avoid time consuming read.bismark step

messages.author: 7a52850c3e5d8eb5
messages.subject: saving myobj to avoid time consuming read.bismark step
parts:
Hi!

Does anyone know of a way to save "myobj" after reading in .sam files using read.bismark()?  The process takes about 20 hours for me and I've needed to do it each time I want to run downstream analysis.  I've tried the getData() function, not sure if i'm using it correctly though. I also need to be able to read in the "myobj" file after saving it.  

I'm doing the analysis remotely in R on Linux, submitting the script in batch mode, which is why objects don't get automatically saved in R.

any advice would be helpful!

thanks in advance!!

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] saving myobj to avoid time consuming read.bismark step
parts:
Hi Brie,

Any R object can be saved using the following command:

save(robj, file="path/to/saved/object.rda")

This is not specific to methylKit!


ᐧ

Regards,
Kalyan
